protocol.title: Cross-sectional options implied-vol TERM-SLOPE basis (BTC-vs-ETH relative near-to-far ATM IV term slope) -> subsequent relative return-tail-asymmetry spread (BTC-minus-ETH forward tail asymmetry): wrapper-free Spearman rank information coefficient (predictiveness) falsification on the real on-disk three-way captures
protocol.extends: EVAL-74 (same causal term_slope reconstruction ``term_slope = IV(near) - IV(far)`` from the real Deribit option trade tape, reused verbatim) and EVAL-77 (same cross-sectional BTC-vs-ETH alignment and ``_relative_signal_series``, reused verbatim) and EVAL-85 (same forward return-tail-asymmetry target, reused verbatim) but a DISTINCT cell: the *cross-sectional term-slope basis* (not the single-underlying term_ratio of EVAL-100, not the cross-sectional level/skew basis of EVAL-77) with the forward relative *tail-asymmetry* spread (not the relative RV spread of EVAL-94); no new acquisition
protocol.supersedes: nothing — this is the cross-sectional term-slope partner to EVAL-100 (own-asset term_ratio -> own tail asymmetry) and EVAL-94 (term_ratio basis -> relative RV); both use the same sealed signal/target reconstructions. It makes a predictiveness claim only, no traded-form / monetization claim

cross_section.target: y_k = tail_asym_BTC(k) - tail_asym_ETH(k) with tail_asym_i(k) = (q95 - median) - (median - q05) over the next H perp log returns strictly after k (relative tail-asymmetry spread)

protocol.signal: causal per-bar implied-vol term slope from the real Deribit option trade tape (EVAL-74 ``_term_bars``): near-ATM trades grouped by expiry; term_slope = IV(near expiry) - IV(far expiry); the term_slope field is overlaid by bar_open_ms onto EVAL-77's common aligned cross-section; the relative series (ETH - BTC) is forward-filled then expanding-zscored end-of-bar k (reused e77._relative_signal_series / e61.expanding_zscore).
protocol.target_detail: forward relative tail-asymmetry spread: per underlying tail_asym = (q95 - median) - (median - q05) over the next H perp log returns (strictly after the decision at bar k, EVAL-85 ``_forward_return_tail_asym`` verbatim), then BTC minus ETH on the common aligned bar grid
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(rel_z_k, y_k) over the common aligned bar-ends (H1: IC > 0, ETH term-slope-richness predicts BTC subsequently carries a richer forward tail-asymmetry spread)

stats.permutation: directional (H1: IC>0), shuffle the relative tail-asymmetry spread

protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on BOTH BTC and ETH floors satisfied, at least one config (term_slope basis x bar grid x horizon) has Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, at least min_usable_pairs_per_config usable pairs, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).
